_source.origin: docker run --rm --network none [-e LANG] <image> sh -c <command>, run on the host (Docker 29.8.2); uniq cases from w2/gnu/shell_tools.json plus EXTRA, help and version recorded in full
_source.locale: centos_7 en_US.UTF-8, debian and ubuntu C.UTF-8, rockylinux_9 unset (en_US.UTF-8 is not installed there: setlocale fails), BusyBox unset
_source.docker_cli_note: the Docker CLI's line on stderr of busybox_1.25.1 (40 of 40 cases; amd64 image on an arm64 host) was removed by hand, not by task-3.8a-record-uniq.py, which does not strip it: it is not output of the program. The removed line: "WARNING: The requested image's platform (linux/amd64) does not match the detected host platform (linux/arm64/v8) and no specific platform was requested". No other image has it (0 of 40).
